findings.title: After a merge the skill waits with --until done, which a merged story never meets
findings.detail:
Two places say to wait with --until done after a merge: Shape ('a PR the person merged → norn story wait <story> --until done --timeout 5m') and the 'Before any gate' line ('wait for the story to end (--until done, not --until gate)'). waitMet 'done' is own(u => u.status === 'done') (packages/view/src/wait.ts). A story the person merges at `ready` is parked at the gate. decide's storyLifecycle (packages/core/src/decide/story.ts:146) emits cleanup_merged_story with story_status done and removes the worktree. It never moves the unit to $done. So the condition never holds: the subagent loops on 5m timeouts, or `story wait` refuses with unknown_unit once the cleaned-up story leaves the view. The same holds when the request names the merge and the supervisor merges. B20: 'the subagent sees the merge and waits for the story to end (GR6)'. The `merged` condition exists for this: 'the story PR merged, or the story is done' (wait.ts header; view/test/unit/wait.test.ts 'merged holds once the PR merged or the story is done'). The assets test pins the wrong term.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Use `norn story wait <story> --until merged --timeout 5m` in both places, and have the subagent report once it is met. Update the assets term to match. The `--until` parse test already accepts `merged`.

findings.title: delegatedText's JSDoc stacked under formatStepTimeline's orphaned one
findings.detail:
The `norn run list <unit> --text` JSDoc was already detached from formatStepTimeline on main (roundEndText sits between them). The new `delegatedText` adds a second comment block right under it, so that doc now reads as if it describes delegatedText.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move formatStepTimeline's JSDoc onto formatStepTimeline, and put delegatedText and roundEndText above it.
